glosses: A move to another place in the hope of curing an addiction etc.

examples.text: At QA they called these 'Geographicals'. It was a common tactic of the alcoholic type to think that a move would make all the difference.
There were always too many geographicals. That is a change of address.

'Doing Geographicals'
The word 'geographical' comes from the recovery community. It refers to one of the actions that an alcoholic mistakenly takes in order to 'fix' their problems.
